attacks.claim: Embargo badge text is hardcoded #ffffff on background var(--surface), which is #ffffff in the default light theme. The text is invisible, failing WCAG 1.4.3 contrast, which is a release requirement. The hardcoded color also ignores the theme tokens.

The unpublish control is a non-focusable span with only an onClick handler. It has no role, no tabindex, no keyboard activation, and no accessible name because the icon is aria-hidden. Keyboard-only and screen-reader editors cannot operate it (WCAG 2.1.1, 4.1.2).
If onUnpublish rejects, the error is unhandled. There is no error feedback and no pending state, so repeated submissions are possible for a destructive action on live content.
attacks.evidence: if (ok) await onUnpublish(draft.id); with no try/catch or loading state

attacks.claim: A trash icon suggests deletion, but the action returns the story to drafts.
Embargo state is computed from the client clock at render time and is never refreshed, so the badge can go stale. No tests are included.
onUnpublish is a new required prop, but no parent call sites are updated in the diff.
attacks.evidence: onUnpublish: (id: string) => Promise<void>; no parent changes
